behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert repeated case-insensitive iterable headers with preserved order, including Set-Cookie.
Assert legacy object arrays and snapshot/returned-array independence.
docDelivery: Document input forms, token validation, lowercase names and space/tab trimming.
Explain first/all values, duplicate order, no joining and immutable snapshot reads.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Ordinary header object or finite pair iterable; ASCII token names; bounded strings, CR/LF/NUL rejected; snapshot semantics.
independence: Support repeated case-insensitive HTTP headers through legacy object and iterable input forms.
